Que-No.2
Ans Significance of Anthropology :-

--- Page 3 ---
i) Anthropology means study of the human behaviour, their cultural, societies from their skeletal investigation, humanities. It helps in the forensic investigation to determine the background and date of the person.

ii) It helps to differentiate between the human and non-human from the skeletal remains which helps in solving the case.

iii) Study the anthropology it helps to determine that it is human skull or animal skull.

iv) Forensic Anthropology helps to solve the case. Like more about forensic, forensic etc. to determine if it human or not?

--- Page 4 ---
vi Forensic anthropology also helps to determine the reason of the death of the individual.
vii It also helps to differentiate between the male and female skeletal structure by their characteristics.
viii Anthropology also helps to determine the age which helps the forensic investigator to solve the case.
Forensic anthropology plays a crucial role in forensic science helps to determine background and cultural of an individual.

--- Page 5 ---
Male skull and female skull their features are different from each other.
It helps to determine that the skull belongs to male or female.
It helps the forensic investigator.
For example, general appearance, frontal eminence, cheek bone shape, projection of chin, angle of jaw. The skull of male differs from the female skull.
There are some characteristics features of the male skull.

--- | ---

Que. 14/
Ans. Portrait parle / Bertillon System-

Portrait parle is also known as 'speaking likeness'.

- It is focused on the subject for the virtual examination.

- Alphonse Bertillon was the person who describe the portrait parle method in 1882.

- He tells that portrait parle helps to identify the criminal by their photo.

- He always clicks the photo of the criminal like-

--- Page 11 ---
- A front view
- A side view

Which helps to identify the characteristic features of the criminal and with on the drug.

- For example if when a crime happened and eye witness saw the face of the suspect then the eye witness tell the look at the suspect to the bertillon which helps to identity the person.

- But after some time biometric methods are more reliable than the portrait parle method.

--- Page 12 ---
Strength of Portrait Parole Method

- Helps to identify the suspect easily
- Helps in the forensic investigation to solve case
- Reliable and give some positive characteristics
- Identity the person by the sketching given from the witness

Weakness

- Biometric Methods are more reliable than Portrait
- Biometric are permanent but portrait not
- Easily available fingerprint marks but portrait not
- Solve the case easily by the fingerprint than portrait

Que- 14.2
Ans - Facial Reconstruction. It is a Method to reconstruct the face of an individual from their skeletal remains.

There are three techniques used in forensic anthropology.
i) Facial Reconstruction
ii) Facial Restoration
iii) Skull / Photographic Superimposition.

- Skull / Photographic Superimposition / Video Superimposition

In this technique two photos are taken and then superimposed on each other. One photo is taken at the front of the skull.

--- Page 14 ---
And other is taken at the downward of the either side. When the photo are superimposed. So it conclude that it is the same person.

2) Facial Restoration: In this method, reconstruct the facial features of an individual. Firstly take a photo on the skull. and markings the point to restore the facial. But it is not more reliable because it is not necessary that the skull is found in proper way.

--- Page 15 ---
Facial Reconstruction. In this method, Reconstruct the facial features of an individual using the methods like clay, paper etc. which helps to identify the person. It gives proper feature on the skull and it is also most helpful.

Manual methods. Manual method are the method which can be done by the method like sketching.

For example - Firstly take the paper then and put on the skull then with the help of the marker sketch the features. After marking then there is a sketch of the skull and then by the identity the feature

Features | Male Skull | Female Skull
--- | --- | ---
1) General appearance | Large | Small
2) Architecture | Rugged | Smooth
3) Orbit | Round with sharp margins | Small with large margins
4) Gonial angle | Angled | Vertical
5) Cheek shape | Broad | Narrow
6) Robusticity | High pronounced | Less pronounced
7) Frontal eminencies | Small | Large
8) Supra-Orbital ridges | Trace or Smooth | Slight or Vertical

--- Page 17 ---
9) Ramus Feature Fland. Less prominent
10) Siz. Large Small
11) Shape of the skull Broad or Round Narrow or Vertical

The morphology characteristics of a male skull and female skull are helpful in Forensic Anthropology.

They help to differentiate that it is a male skull or female skull.

From the morphological feature forensic investigations also determine the sex from the individual.

In case of disasters found that Forensic Investigators their it is male because their skull is large compare to the female skull.

If the skull is less prominent and small it is conclude that it is female.

Ans Human skeletal system
In Human skeleton system three bones are present.
They are divided into two parts
Axial skeleton
Appendicular skeleton
Axial skeleton - Axial skeleton is defined as the center core of the axis. In axial skeleton there are 80 bones are present.
In the skull fissure are 22 bones are present.

(4) Coccyx
(4) Sternum
(5) Ribs

Que - 18.1
Ans Somatometric Measurements

1) Head (g-op)- It is the measurement from the glabella to the opithocranion

Glabella - Glabella is present in the front of the forehead.
- It is present b/w the two eyebrows.

Opithocranion - It is present in at the side of head.
- It is present in the middle of head of the back side

--- Page 23 ---
2 Face - It is the measurement b/w the Acronion & the opithocranion

3 Nose - (N-sn). It is the measurement b/w from the nasion and Subnasion.

Nasion - Nasion is the present at the point of nose below the eyebrows.

Subnasion - Subnasion are present on the tip of nose.

4 Height - Height of a person Can take from the following steps.

5 Stand the person straight (90°) angle with barefoot.

--- Page 24 ---
(3) Then ask him to stand with the wall with barefoot and toe touch to the wall.
(4) Head are relaxed and placed in front of the thighs.
(4) Face are straight at the 90°
(5) Then, take the measurement from the toe to the end of the head.

Instrument - Measuring tape.

(5) Weight of the person.
(6) Ask the person to stand on the weighing machine with barefoot.
(7) There hands are not touch h

--- Page 25 ---
The Weighting machine.

1) Weight the person with minimal clothes and barefoot.

2) Ask the person to stand straight.

3) Before measuring the weight, the scale would be 0.

4) After 0 ask the person to start on it and when the scale is stop write down the weight.

Instrument: weighing machine.

Somato metric measurements (head, face, nose, height, weight) in terms of reliability and accuracy is helpful in the personal identification.

--- Page 26 ---
Every person has different characteristics and also their weight and height different.

By the somatometric measurements person forensic investigators to find the individual on the basic of their physical characteristics for the personal identification.

--- Page 27 ---
Strength of facial superimposition techniques

1) Facial superimposition technique helps to find out missing persons from their skeletal remains.

2) By the superimposition technique, forensic investigators try to draw the face of individual.

3) It is helpful when no other evidence is found.

4) It takes some time but gives accurate results if the skull is in a proper way.

5) It also help in reconstruct the scene and identifying the individuals.

--- Page 28 ---
Limitations -

1 It takes more time.
2 If the skull is not found in a proper way it cannot give accurate measurements.
3 It is less reliable.
4 In the case of the mass disaster it cannot be less the superimposition technique chosen it can not give positive results.
5 During examination may be mistakes happen like not proper marking. Compute function not work properly.

Que-20-1
Ans Role of Forensic odontology in mass disaster cases is very good method to identify the person on the basis of dental records

- If the teeth are missing it helps to identify the victim.
- Spacing present between the teeth.
- Size of teeth.
- Any anomalies like caps are present.
- Also determine the age from the teeth.
- Also know the sex.

--- Page 30 ---
- Dental records are unique to each individual.
- Not everyone teeth are same.
- Teeth are the main evidence when no other evidence is found.
- It gives information of the individual.
- Forensic Odontology can determine the accurate identification from the teeth.
- There are different variations present in the teeth.
